old_problem: The source expects Reading=2 to trigger an 'above 2' UpperCaution event, hardcodes OAM_7, uses malformed unauthenticated PATCH examples and restores null state with an empty string. DeepSeek loses the configuration/rollback coverage.
disposition_reason: Pending remains only for the core trigger oracle. DMTF Redfish defines UpperCaution and ReadingAboveUpperCautionThreshold as reading above the threshold; it does not authorize treating equality as above. The source explicitly expects 2 at threshold 2, so standard documentation cannot reconcile the OEM-inclusive behavior. Dynamic mapping, ordered authenticated PATCH, injection evidence and exact snapshot rollback are fully parameterized, but an approved project/BMC specification must decide equality or provide a different stimulus count.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2091, its DeepSeek cells, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity, ED-01 through ED-30 and official DMTF Redfish Sensor/message definitions were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2092 / Wistron-BMC-01067-V002 / 00d9484061a0c643 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
DMTF describes UpperCaution as the value at which the reading is above normal and the standard message as Reading above UpperCaution; equality is not specified as above.
The Master row nevertheless requires the event text for Reading 2 and threshold 2, creating a project/OEM acceptance conflict that cannot be fixed by guessing >= or silently injecting a third CE.
Resolve OAM and sensor URI from live device/SocketId mapping; OAM_7 and example BDFs are never assumed.
Use authenticated HTTPS, writable-property/schema check, ETag/If-Match where supported, ordered CeWindow-then-threshold PATCHes and readback; malformed `curl k` is not executable.
Capture the exact pre-state and restore those values transactionally; never substitute empty string for baseline null without OEM schema approval.
The exact one-shot d0/b0/s2/t4/address injection and corrected UMC ext0 ODECC CPER remain gated on address ownership, isolation and recovery.
No Redfish GET/PATCH, mapping, injection, CPER retrieval, rollback, recovery, log clear, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Mapped HBM CE threshold transaction with authoritative trigger rule — GATE-CLOSED DRAFT
test_case.purpose: After the BMC owner resolves equality semantics, configure the mapped HBM CE window/threshold, trigger the approved boundary with one UMC ODECC injection, correlate threshold warning and corrected CPER, and restore the exact original sensor state.
required_package: BMC/OEM signed statement defining whether UpperCaution 2 triggers at Reading 2 or an approved alternate event-count oracle
Live GPU/card/SocketId/OAM/sensor URI map and safe 0x800000000 ownership
Authenticated HTTPS Redfish account, Sensor/OEM schema, writable properties and rollback payload
Compatible amdgpuras, amd-smi and cdump_analyzer builds
Dedicated SUT, PATCH/injection point approvals, complete CPER/EventLog access and recovery
test_case.test_command: DO NOT PATCH OR INJECT until trigger semantics are signed. Then capture the full sensor resource/ETag, topology, EventLog, Dump and in-band baseline; after approval PATCH CeWindow to PT10M, verify, PATCH UpperCaution to 2, verify Enabled, and after separate approval execute `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 2 -t 4 -a 0x800000000` once. Collect all new EventLog/Dump/attachments and in-band CPER. Finally restore the exact captured pre-state with conditional authenticated PATCH and verify it. Do not use raw HTTP, `-k`, hardcoded OAM_7, log clearing or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be finalized until the OEM trigger rule is approved. Under that rule, the mapped sensor emits the approved boundary warning, and the sole injection yields a corrected target-OAM UMC ext=0 On-die-ECC CPER with matching OOB/in-band identity. The exact original CeWindow/threshold/state and platform health are restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while equal-versus-greater trigger semantics are unresolved. After unlock, PASS requires dynamic identity, ordered authenticated configuration/readback, exactly the approved event count, correct warning, exact corrected ext0 CPER, complete correlation and verified snapshot rollback. FAIL on wrong sensor/OAM/address, unapproved extra injection, absent/mismatched event or any rollback/health failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until OEM trigger comparison, live identity/address, PATCH schema and exact rollback are signed.
Separate human approvals are required for monitoring-state mutation and the RAS injection.
Preserve complete resources/logs and use conditional authenticated changes; do not clear evidence.
Stop without reinjection on unexpected reading/event, GPU issue, concurrent resource change or rollback failure.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, official Redfish comparison finding and signed OEM trigger decision
Live device/card/OAM/sensor/address map, tool/schema versions and approvals
Complete original sensor JSON/ETag plus ordered PATCH responses and readbacks
Full one-shot injection output and timestamped sensor/GPU/system chronology
Complete authenticated EventLog/Dump manifests, every new attachment and corrected UMC ext0 decode with in-band match
Conditional restoration response, exact baseline equality, post-health, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If the boundary event differs, injection affects the wrong target, the resource changes concurrently or rollback fails, stop and preserve all artifacts. Do not add an extra CE or guess a disable payload; execute only the signed restoration/contingency and quarantine monitoring or the SUT until owner release.
